falsifiedOneShotAssumption.statement: The first capture_backdrop invocation reaching symbol+0x2b58 has the mirrored-rectangle identity observed in all 114 filtered path-isolation operand records.
falsifiedOneShotAssumption.permittedInference: The exact filtered operand state may occur after one or more earlier capture_backdrop invocations; the failed artifact alone does not identify which mirrored field differed or prove why.

frozenRetryDelta.selectionRule: Keep the late symbol+0x2b58 breakpoint enabled across rejected candidates and select only the first invocation whose nonzero x19/x20/x24/layerState pointer chain is exact and whose source+0x50, layerState+0xb0, and owner+0xe0 rectangles are exactly identical under their frozen int32/binary64 decoding.
frozenRetryDelta.rejectedCandidateRule: Retain the first 16 rejected candidates in call order. Each diagnostic records the live object pointers, pointer-chain classification, and, when that chain is exact, the source/layer int32 rectangles plus exact raw source/layer/owner rectangle bytes. Rejected candidates never arm or retarget a watchpoint.
frozenRetryDelta.candidateLimitRule: If no exact candidate is found by invocation 512, fail closed, disable the late breakpoint, retain the bounded diagnostics, and upload the raw trace.

frozenQuestion.objective: Reach the exact filtered private-crop object state without assuming it is the first capture_backdrop invocation, then capture the exact Apple instruction PCs and call stacks that change the already-proven private crop fields.
frozenQuestion.entryRule: Set one pending breakpoint by the exact capture_backdrop symbol. On its first hit, read exactly 0x4000 bytes from the symbol address and require SHA-256 14f25960556bec9e88ba8ade176ee7f1d39b84726226ade3eb1b0f1be00b70d2 before setting the bounded candidate breakpoint at symbol+0x2b58.
frozenQuestion.candidateRule: Inspect at most 512 symbol+0x2b58 invocations. A selected candidate must require source=x19, owner=x20, layer=x24, layerState=*(layer+0x10), *(source+0x48)=owner, *(layerState+0x120)=source, and exact equality of source+0x50, layerState+0xb0, and owner+0xe0 after fixed int32/binary64 decoding. No nonmatching candidate can arm a watchpoint.
frozenQuestion.watchpointRule: On the first exact candidate, arm exactly four 8-byte hardware write-on-modify watchpoints: source+0x50, owner+0xe0, owner+0x248, and that candidate's layerState+0xb0. Retain at most six changed-value events per watchpoint and at most 24 events total. A debugger callback never mutates target memory and returns false to resume the target.
frozenQuestion.eventRule: For each event retain the exact before and after eight bytes, stop PC, thread ID, at most 32 frames, all six private post-write fields, and one deduplicated mapped code window. A resolved writer symbol retains exactly 0x1000 bytes from its symbol start; an unresolved writer retains exactly 0x400 bytes beginning 0x200 bytes before the stop PC.
frozenQuestion.integrityRule: Require a selected exact candidate, exactly four distinct hardware watchpoint indices, at least one changed QuartzCore event for every preregistered field, contiguous per-field hit indices, exact code-window hashes, zero LLDB failures, and a finalized raw trace.
frozenQuestion.semanticSeal: The CI validator may prove only bounded candidate selection, trace integrity, and writer-PC capture. Rejected-candidate meaning, function semantics, writer order, arithmetic, and the public layer-state crop rule remain sealed until the artifact is opened after the run.
frozenQuestion.nullOutcome: A changed code hash, no exact candidate within 512 invocations, partial pointer chain, unavailable hardware slot, missing field event, non-QuartzCore writer, partial code window, callback failure, or target failure fails closed and remains an uploaded artifact.
